newsitem.title: MOROCCO: King Hassan receives Tunisian prime minister.
newsitem.headline: King Hassan receives Tunisian prime minister.

text.p: King Hassan of Morocco conferred with visiting Tunisian Prime Minister Hamed Karoui on Thursday on bilateral, regional and international issues, Moroccan radio RTM said.
Karoui, who arrived on Wednesday in Rabat, earlier met Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali to discuss the situation in the Maghreb and Middle East.
Morocco and Tunisia are members of the five-nation Arab Maghreb Union, along with Algeria, Libya and Mauritania.
Karoui met the king at the royal palace in Skhirat, 20 km (12 miles) south of Rabat, for nearly one hour, officials said.
Diplomats said Karoui was apparently laying the groundwork for a visit by Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali, and gave the king a message from him.
It would be the first official visit to Morocco since Ben Ali became president of Tunisia in 1987, they added.
Karoui is expected to leave Morocco for home on Friday after visiting the Hassan II mosque in Casablanca.
